comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-004 (high, tdd). Populated after the independent quality-gate evaluator (identity ledger seq0329, reports/quality-gate/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/T-004.md, VERDICT: PASS) independently re-ran all 10 T-004 suites (60/60) and independently reproduced RED by disabling the full_upgrade_required backstop and the NEW-01 grammar check, confirming failure, then restoring a clean tree with matching hashes. stack:shell waives the three compile-oriented checks {lint, typecheck, build}: this task's Planned Files are a Markdown skill file (plugins/sdd-lite/skills/lite-gate/SKILL.md) plus bash/PowerShell test scripts, and no lint/typecheck/build toolchain is configured in this repository for either. unit-tests and acceptance-tests share the same evidence (verification/T-004.{red,green}.log) because T-004's own 5 suite pairs simultaneously exercise unit-level simulator behavior and the task's own acceptance criteria (AC-011..018, AC-026, AC-030) in the same assertions -- there is no separate acceptance-only fixture set for this task. regression evidence (verification/qg/T-004/regression-{sh,ps1}.log) re-runs T-001/T-002/T-003's own suites, since T-004's own tests/run-all.sh/.ps1 edit is the only shared-file touch this task makes with those tasks' own registration. requirement-traceability evidence is against specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/traceability.json, a machine-readable companion to the already-frozen traceability.md authored at this contract's own authoring time (mirrors the specs/epic-159-pillar-d/traceability.json precedent) -- it is not itself a change to any frozen artifact, and it covers this feature's REQ-002..REQ-006 (REQ-001 is Deferred per traceability.md's own Deferred Requirements section and carries no task or evidence). KNOWN, DOCUMENTED, NON-BLOCKING CONDITION (not a T-004 defect): plugins/sdd-quality-loop/scripts/check-workflow-state.sh currently exits 1 for this feature due to a pre-existing gap in that script's own task-lifecycle status regex, which does not recognize the Blocked lifecycle state T-001/T-002/T-003 legitimately carry pending a separate, already-reported R-10 human-copy guard-gap decision (tasks.md T-001's own Blocker addendum documents this in full, with the exact grep evidence). This is a feature-wide, human-decision-blocked governance-tooling gap unrelated to and unaffected by T-004's own change; it is not cited here as a basis for withholding any of this contract's checks, but it is why T-004's own Status remains Implementation Complete rather than Done pending that script's own one-line human-applied fix.
